regulation_clause.text: Closure requests must be honoured within 7 working days (subject to dues); failure incurs a penalty of Rs 500 per calendar day of delay until closure, provided no outstanding.

gold.gold_rationale: Clause 19 requires a 7-working-day closure SLA backed by a ₹500/calendar-day penalty. CLOSPEN4 accepts WS-ELAPSED-DAYS as input but never uses it: 2000-CLOSE-ACCT only checks WS-OUTSTANDING and marks BLOCKED/CLOSED. The trailing comment '* NOTE: SLA TRACKING TBD' (line 27) is the program's own acknowledgment that the SLA/penalty logic is unimplemented.
